newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil prisoners take hostages after foiled escape.
newsitem.headline: Brazil prisoners take hostages after foiled escape.

text.p: Three prisoners were holding an unknown number of hostages in a jail in the northeastern Brazilian town of Recife after an unsuccessful break-out attempt during visiting hour, a prison official said on Sunday.
Local Globo television said police believed around 30 people were being held hostage although other visitors who managed to escape said the number was much higher.
"We are not sure how many hostages there are," the prison official said.
One policeman was shot and killed during the foiled escape attempt, Globo said. This could not be confirmed independently by local police or prison officials.
Around 70 people including 20 children were waiting to pass through security when the prisoners tried to escape but they all managed to get out of the building through a hole in the wall, Globo said.
The prison official said that authorities were negotiating with the three prisoners.
"Things are under control. We hope it will be over soon," he said.
